Overview

Taza is a city in Fès-Meknès with a population of 148,000. A historic mountain city in the Rif region, known for its strategic location and traditional crafts. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6a growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 265 sunny days a year. Reported crime rates are relatively low. The population skews young, with a median age of 30.0.
